description: Flower 是一個相對窄的概念，因此真正自然的全面近義詞不多。 本課不為了數量加入牽強詞，而是把重點放在 tree blossom, open bloom, composite flower head, small floret, inflorescence, and broader flowering structure 之間的差別。

words.example: The cherry trees are covered in pale pink blossom.
words.exampleZh: 櫻花樹上開滿淡粉紅色花朵。

exercises.original: The apple tree was covered in white flowers by early April.

options.explanation: Blossom ✓ — a flower or mass of flowers, especially on a fruit tree or flowering tree。這句的決定性線索是 flowers on a fruit tree are being described。因此 Blossom 最準確表達這種 flower。
Bloom — a flower, especially one that is fully open or visually striking。bloom 偏已盛開、具視覺美感的花；如果重點是樹花、花頭或技術結構，就不夠準。
Petal — one coloured part of a flower。petal 只是花瓣，是整朵 flower 的其中一部分。
Bud — an unopened developing flower。bud 是尚未開放的花蕾，不能代替已開放的 flower。
Pollen — fine reproductive material produced by flowers。pollen 是花粉，不是花本身或花序結構。
Leaf — a flat plant organ usually involved in photosynthesis。leaf 是葉，不是花。
